name: FortressProtocol
report: The submit function lacked validation of the signer and voting power, allowing attackers to modify the fcds state variable and manipulate the price oracle. This enabled the attacker to pass a malicious governance proposal to set an inflated collateral factor, then profit via arbitrage.
report_zh: submit函数缺乏对签名者和投票权的验证，允许攻击者修改fcds状态变量并操纵价格预言机。这使得攻击者能够通过恶意治理提案设定夸大的抵押因子，然后通过套利获利。
